reviews.title: Joke of company
reviews.text:
I was with Visible for over two years. I recommended them to everyone and brought them a lot of customers. Everything was "fine" because nothing had ever gone wrong. The first time I had a real problem, I found out this company is a joke.
My phone was stolen in a robbery. My whole identity was stolen with it. And Visible put me through hell.
It took more than 20 days to get my own phone number back. Twenty days locked out of my number, my iCloud, my photos, my memories, everything depended on that number, and they dragged it out like it was nothing.
Reaching help is a nightmare. Endless waiting to get an agent, and the agents don't know what they're doing. I was bounced from agent to agent, and every time I had to start completely over — re-enter my number, re-explain everything, over and over again. Zero professionalism, zero organization.
And the supervisors were the worst part. They kept demanding a card from me when I had explained, again and again, that my cards were stolen with my identity and I was waiting for replacements — they literally could not understand that. And their brilliant solution? "Maybe you can borrow a card from a friend." Borrow a card from a friend. That's the level of this company.
They scheduled me a callback — "Wednesday at 4, we will call you" — and never called. Nobody called. So I had to go back into the same waiting hell from the beginning.

reviews.title: Terrible hours long carrier transfer with no phone call assistance
reviews.text: I initiated switching from Verizon to Visible for my family’s 4 phone lines. I was excited to switch, but the process in the visible app, from start to finish, was a nightmare. Horribly glitchy. My experience took over 3 hours. I utilized the virtual live agent which did help, but we had to try so many troubleshooting tactics to get anything to work. I wanted to setup in the browser to avoid the app glitches, but the browser just redirected me to finish setting up in the app. It was a continuous, vicious loop where every inquiry led to an error message that was endlessly frustrating (and I’m relatively tech savvy). Then I directed my other 3 family members to switch their lines (since each line is independent) and my mother experienced far worse. She spent half a day getting her line transferred (same glitchy issues in the app), where nothing in the entire account setup and transfer process worked as it should. All four of us had an arduous process and I honestly don’t understand how anyone has remote success using this app to sign up for phone service. I hope that visible makes many improvements to the app experience and could provide a call line to get more direct, immediate support and resolution.
